notes.title: "Pretty Girls Four Kings Solitaire" How to play!
notes.content:
[How to play]
The game is cleared if you can move all the cards to the table in the specified order.

[Rules]
1.At the beginning of the game, there is a set of cards on the table.
(1) Deck of cards
(2) Hand cards
(3) Field cards
(4) The table
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42044636/0fb61a23ed3a2d1ff6b0311f4fcd4216b3104f28.png

2.A card is turned over from the deck, and that card becomes your hand.
The card in your hand can be put on the field or on the table.
The cards in your hand are automatically replenished when you put them on the field or table.
※The cards in your hand can be placed on the table only when the following conditions are met.
※You can't move the cards you put on the table
※You can place any suit on the table.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42044636/d5168a4e7186041c999404f825591a6ad5105dbe.png

3.Only the top card on the field can be moved to the table.
※ Cards placed on the field cannot be moved to another pile on the field.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42044636/867332b79a255875cb4b0ccf5b0f0c7dded52a4f.png

4.If you can move all the cards in the deck, hand, and field to the table, you have cleared the game.

5.Help Functions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42044636/2db87b987992b0f0dc8eadcd12a79f79925a7e76.png
(1) Expose
Replenish cards from the deck until you have 5 cards in your hand.
※You can only move the first card in your hand.
Each time you use this function, 10 seconds are added to your time.

(2) Move (Usage Limit: 5)
Move one card from the field to the table.
It automatically moves a card from the field to the table pile with the least number of cards.
Each time you use this, 20 seconds are added to your time.

(3) Shuffle (Usage Limit: 1)
All the cards in the field are returned to the deck.
Each time you use it, 60 seconds are added to your time.

(4) Undo
Returns the moved card to it's original location.
